claim: Farm, Orchard and Foresters' Hub workers prepare every marked field or plot before they plant any of them, so marking a big farm at once delays the first harvest. At the Orchard and Foresters' Hub the workers also have to raise seedlings, which takes time too. With no plots to prepare they start seedlings ahead of time, but the fastest way to get trees in the ground is to prepare a few plots, then let them start seedlings: they plant each one as soon as it is ready.
notes: Matches the game data: the Farm, Greenhouse, Orchard, Foresters' Hub and Oasis each have a BuildSiteBuilderBehaviour listing their field and tree build sites, so a marked plot is a build site their workers build. A villager's ActivityWorkOnBuilderWorkplace (working a build site) has importance 0.91, above ActivityWorkOnWorkplace (workplace work such as planting) at 0.90; only ActivityExtractResource (harvesting) ranks higher at 0.92. Orchards, Foresters' Hubs and Oases raise each tree as a seedling: about 15.5 s of worker time to start it (" -> GrowingSapling"), then 128 s growing in one of 16 beds without a worker ("GrowingSapling -> Sapling").
